static_observations.finding: Release-unit write permission plus write:repository scope required for scoped credentials; ordinary read response cannot prove no draft exists
Draft does not create tag; publishing can use existing tag; resolve Tag commit independently instead of trusting target_commitish
Empty note/title is not assigned by handler; empty-body clearing needs a real negative case
Supports multipart and raw bytes; metadata endpoint returns no content digest; download bytes needed for SHA-256
Separate Basic/packages Bearer chain and /v2/token, not ordinary OAuth Bearer middleware
Owner visibility and organization/team package permissions are evaluated independently from a linked repository
Existing client accepts JSON/form and decodes non-JSON as text; raw bytes and allowed response headers needed before binary checks
